agent_explanation: Controller balances pole (theta ~ -0.08 at violation) but with seeded sensor noise the state estimate / feedback slowly drives cart negative; velocity grows increasingly negative (-0.19 at step 100, -0.39 at 200, -0.80 at 300, -1.37 at 374) causing unbounded drift off track. Zeroing noise removes failure, implicating noise-biased feedback / lack of cart centering.
